For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“Exposure to the Wasteland has made you more resilient.”

**Rad Resistant** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Increased Radiation Resistance based on current Endurance.

| ![FO76 rad resistant perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/2/20/FO76_rad_resistant_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Radiation Resistance | 
| | 1 | +18 | 
| | 15 | +61 | 
| | 30 | +96 | 
| | 60 | +131 | 
| | 100 | +175 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Radiation Resistance based on your END. | 001D2479 | 

Before update 58, Rad Resistant had 4 ranks and provided +10/+20/+30/+40 Radiation Resistance.

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Adamantium Skeleton - Less limb damage
- Iron Stomach - Bonus Damage and Energy Resistance
- Lead Belly - Less radiation from eating and drinking
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Natural Resistance - Bonus elemental resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
- Vaccinated - Higher Disease Resistance
